# Pitch 0001: Shopping list from recipes

## Problem

Cooks retype ingredients into a separate shopping list app.

## Appetite

10 % of the weekly limit.

## Solution

Add a recipe's ingredients to one shopping list, merging repeated items.

## Rabbit holes

- Unit conversion between recipes: out of scope, items are merged by exact name.

## No-gos

- No sharing lists with other people.
